text: Spin Attack Once, Settle All Bleeds

Enhanced Falcon Toss, leap into the air and gather wind power, launching a fierce wind blade spear. Deals 750% ATK as Attack DMG to all enemies in the area and significantly reduces their tenacity, growing with the upgrade/advancement of the Falcon Toss skill.
Immediately gain 3 stacks of Sharp after Casting .

Deals <style="magic">Magic DMG</style> equal to <style="accent-gn">500%</style> ATK to enemies hit along the path, and heals allies hit for <style="accent-gn">100%</style> ATK. Scales with the Level/Tier of <style="accent-gn">Special attack</style>. Casting it immediately refreshes Infusion.
Resonates with the power from Boss Muku Chief. Smashes the ground around, dealing high area <style="physical">Attack DMG</style>. Can be charged <style="accent-gn">2</style> times.

Phantom Scythe Wheel
Approach the target at lightning speed, then creates a Phantom Scythe Wheel, dealing Thunder Element damage for 3s, striking every 0.5s.

Tips: Reliable Attack skill when enemy movement is unpredictable. Great for dealing massive DMG.

Consumes 50 Rage and 5 Sand Crystals. Unleashes a mighty roar, dealing Attack DMG to nearby enemies, interrupting their actions, and granting an all-DMG-absorbing Shield. (Shields may be stacked, with a maximum capacity equivalent to 150% of maximum HP.) Reduces Attack DMG taken from the target by 10% for 12s.

Tips: Provides damaging capabilities when survival pressure is minimal and grants greater Armor in situations where enemies predominantly inflict Attack DMG.

Gathers sand around yourself, dealing a burst of Attack DMG to surrounding enemies. The sand then solidifies, dealing Attack DMG to surrounding enemies every second for 6s. Throughout this effect, continuously regenerates Rage and Sand Crystal, providing 33 Rage and 6 Sand Crystals.

Tips: Keep it active as often as possible. The continuous AoE DMG poses a great threat to the enemies while generating Rage quickly.

Channels the power of sandstone, automatically countering Lethal Skills for the next 10s, while increasing Armor and reducing DMG taken by 20%.

Tips: Use in high-pressure battles to greatly improve survival.

Enhanced Star Shatter. Lunges at the enemy, dealing Attack DMG equal to 500% ATK, knocking them airborne. Scales with the Level/Tier of Star Shatter.
Gains double Rage and becomes Enraged.

Quickly draws the bow to fire 5 arrows at the target, each dealing Attack DMG and generating 1 Photon Energy.
This skill holds 2 charges.
When Photon Energy reaches max, Storm Arrow instantly gains 2 charges, and the max number of charges increases to 5.

Tips: Even after five uses, Storm Arrow will continue to re-charge. Use other skills to buy time for more casts.

Charges and then fires a piercing arrow that deals Attack DMG and Knockback to all enemies in its path. Cannot knock back targets with Resilience, but reduces targets' Resilience. Powerdraw deals a bonus 100% Crit DMG.
This skill holds 2 charges.
No charge time required when in Photon Reforge state.

Tips: Great for reducing enemies' Resilience while dealing area damage.

Leaps high and slams your guitar into the ground to burst sparks, dealing Magic DMG to the enemies within range.
Each instance of DMG dealt by Amplified Beat (only once per multi-target hit) increases the hit count of Harmonic Anthem by 1, up to 3.

Tips: Master the Amplified Beat's mechanic of increasing hit count to boost Harmonic Anthem's Attack.

Consumes 1 Holy Sigil to deliver a powerful shield bash to enemies in front, dealing Attack DMG and increasing your Armor, stacking up to 3 times.

Tips: Monitor the Armor buff from Valor Bash and try to keep it active at all times.
Deals <style="physical">Attack DMG</style> equal to <style="accent-gn">200%</style> ATK to the enemy (which scales with the Level/Tier of <style="accent-gn">Basic Attack</style>).

Empowered <linktext=1563><style="ItemQuality_5">Reckoning</style></linktext> deals <style="accent-gn">2</style> times the normal DMG of <linktext=1563><style="ItemQuality_5">Reckoning</style></linktext>, starts at <style="accent-gn">250%</style> Crit DMG, and does not consume <style="accent-gn">Holy Sigils</style>, but still generates Holy <style="accent-gn">Energy</style>.

Unleashes a powerful energy pulse, dealing massive DMG upon surrounding enemies and stunning them.
If the enemy possesses Super Armor, it will instead deal high Super Armor DMG.
Inflicts a Hostility Mark on all enemies within 5 meters. Marked enemies will increasingly build up Hostility on you, and every attack against them restores your HP.
Calls down divine energy to heal yourself and all <style="accent-gn">allies</style>, and reduces the <style="accent-gn">CD </style> of all your Weapon skills.
Surrounds yourself in pure Energy, restoring HP and granting <style="accent-gn">DMG Immunity</style> for <style="accent-gn">3</style>. You cannot take any other actions during this time.

<style="accent-gn">Summons Boss</style>: Tempest Ogre and channels the power of thunder to generate a vortex, continuously pulling in enemies near the target and dealing AoE <style="magic">Magic DMG</style> when the duration ends.

Summons Boss: Frost Ogre to execute a spinning attack with an ice hammer, resulting in Attack DMG and freezing all targets on hit.
Upon the skill cast, your Resilience Break Bonus is increased for a period.

Transforms into Elite: Shadow Captain to launch an Electro Bomb at the designated target, dealing AoE Attack DMG and interrupting the target's actions.
Upon the skill cast, the DMG dealt and healing of your Expertise Skill are increased for a period.
<style="accent-gn">Transforms into Elite</style>: Void Arachnocrab, and gains <style="accent-gn">Invincibility</style> for <style="accent-gn">5s</style>.

Summons Elite: Brigand Scout Leader to execute continuous attacks on the designated target, dealing Attack DMG and interrupting their actions.
Upon the skill cast, your Agility is increased for a period.

Transforms into Boss: Golden Juggernaut, granting yourself and 10 allies Shield. When dealing DMG, the shielded targets generate Thunderstrike (CD: 0.5s), and the DMG dealt depends on the friendly ATK.
(This effect cannot stack and only one will be effective.)

<style="accent-gn">Summons Boss</style>: Lizardman King to deal Ice <style="physical">Attack DMG</style> to nearby enemies and <linktext=3001><style="ItemQuality_5">Silence</style></linktext> them for <style="accent-gn">10s</style>.
Resonance Rune Power: Blocks incoming attacks from the front
Increases Movement SPD for a period of time. Recharges 200% faster while airborne.
Heavy assault, the giant's silhouette tears through the sky amidst the roar of the engine!
Explodes after a short countdown, blasting nearby players away

Unleashes a Time Freeze Domain.Targets entering the domain are frozen in time. The domain lasts 5s.
Also affects other Shadow Hunters.
"This is awesome!"

Conjures an Ice Wall behind the user for 5s.
The Ice Wall blocks movement and projectiles, and reduces nearby Shadow Hunters' movement speed by 30%.
Tip: The Ice Wall crushes any targets beneath it when it appears.

Consumes 10 HP to attack with Denvel's greatsword.
If the attack hits a Stalker, restores 50 HP.
Killing a Stalker fully restores HP.
Cannot be used when HP is insufficient.
The actual damage is calculated based on the Armor of the object the Stalker has transformed into.
Weapon Special Effect: Fires 2 additional blades of energy and clears all non-player objects within range.
"With this, I purge the sorrows of the past."
